gloss: to confine; to shut in; to cram in

definitions.gloss: to confine, to shut in, to lock away
definitions.explanation: To force someone or something into a confined space and keep them there. Can be used for physical confinement or figurative suppression.

definitions.gloss: to cram in, to stuff in, to force into
definitions.explanation: To push or force something into a tight or limited space.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}を{部屋|へや}に{押|お}し{込|こ}めた。
examples.english: They confined the criminal in a room.

examples.japanese: {不満|ふまん}を{心|こころ}の{中|なか}に{押|お}し{込|こ}めていた。
examples.english: I had been suppressing my dissatisfaction inside.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{一日中|いちにちじゅう}{家|いえ}に{押|お}し{込|こ}められた。
examples.english: I was stuck at home all day because of the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}をスーツケースに{押|お}し{込|こ}めた。
examples.english: I crammed the luggage into the suitcase.

examples.japanese: {大量|たいりょう}の{書類|しょるい}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}しに{押|お}し{込|こ}めた。
examples.english: I stuffed a large amount of documents into the drawer.

examples.japanese: {狭|せま}い{部屋|へや}に{十人|じゅうにん}も{押|お}し{込|こ}められて、{息|いき}が{苦|くる}しかった。
examples.english: Ten of us were crammed into a small room, and it was hard to breathe.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
Ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし}).
- Negative: {押|お}し{込|こ}めない
- Polite: {押|お}し{込|こ}めます
- Te-form: {押|お}し{込|こ}めて
- Past: {押|お}し{込|こ}めた
- Passive: {押|お}し{込|こ}められる

USAGE:
The passive form {押|お}し{込|こ}められる is very common, especially for describing being stuck or confined somewhere against one's will. The figurative usage in sense 1 (suppressing emotions) is also frequent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部屋|へや}に{押|お}し{込|こ}める: to confine in a room
- {感情|かんじょう}を{押|お}し{込|こ}める: to suppress feelings
- スーツケースに{押|お}し{込|こ}める: to cram into a suitcase
